overview.text: Maritza Travanti is the incumbent Monrovia Unified School District Board member for Trustee Area 5, first elected in 2018, and has served as Board President. She retired after a 35-year IRS career, where she was Chief of Operations and Program Support. During her tenure on the board, the district navigated COVID-19 and returned students to in-person learning in 2021. She says she helped guide a Fiscal Stabilization Plan and middle school consolidation.
